# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

coastal_forest <- read_csv(here("data", "theme1_coastal_forest.csv"))
```

# Tasks

1. Build a boxplot comparing `tree_species` on the x-axis vs. `dbh_cm` on the y-axis.
2. Fill the boxplots using the `"plasma"` viridis palette option.
3. Apply `theme_minimal()`.
4. Hide the redundant species color legend using `theme(legend.position = "none")`.

Write your boxplot code below:

```{r}
ggplot(coastal_forest, aes(x = tree_species, y = dbh_cm, fill = tree_species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Tree DBH Distribution by Species",
    x = "Mangrove Species",
    y = "Diameter at Breast Height (cm)"
  )
```
